description: The newly exposed diagnostic does not validate the destination histogram capacity.
trigger: Call test_distribution with valid contiguous CUDA float32 input, ref_output containing N bins where 1 <= N <= 1024, and dist_output containing fewer than N float32 elements.
expected_behavior: Reject the mismatched output capacity before launching the kernel.
actual_behavior: The wrapper derives N solely from ref_output; write_histogram writes N floats through dist_output's raw pointer without checking its size, potentially writing beyond its allocation. Reach is direct extension callers; no parent-tree callers or new workflow call sites were found.

verification.description: Traced ref_output.numel() through the launch argument to both output-writing loops and inspected the complete wrapper checks and caller search.
verification.limits: No malformed invocation was executed; memory corruption or a specific CUDA error was not observed.
